Natural Resources Canada, Office of Energy Efficiency / Canadian Industry Program for Energy Conservation (CIPEC) (2001). Energy Consumption Benchmark Guide: Cement Clinker Production. Cat. No. M27-01-1464E. Ottawa. Data mainly from the Cement Association of Canada, drawing on the U.S. and Canadian Portland Cement Industry: Plant Information Summary for 1998.

14-page brochure; locators are the printed page numbers (page 1 = Industry Background; PDF page = printed + 2). Year 2001 confirmed by the imprint. Only three technology-type values are printed (Holderbank 1993 fuel use for wet, single-stage-preheater and multi-stage-preheater dry kilns, reprinted); the rest is fleet statistics (1998 data, 15 plants), loaded under kiln_clinker-fleet-* names that map to no archetype. No cost, electricity-per-tonne or emissions numbers are printed; electricity per t is only derivable (approx. 154 kWh/t, see other-values, assumption flagged). Fuel-only (Holderbank) and total-energy (fleet) rows are different bases: the fleet totals include electricity at 3.598 GJ/MWh. Figures 3 and 4 are bar charts with no printed values and were not read. Heating-value basis never stated.
